text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, and I’m a Python-focused developer with 6 years of experience building machine learning and backend systems.

I’d be excited to help maintain and improve your ecommerce platform, especially given the mix of Django, scaling concerns, and practical AI work in the product. My background includes Python, machine learning, NLP, scikit-learn, PyTorch, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas, so I’m comfortable working on data-driven applications and the kinds of backend workflows that support them.

A project that is especially relevant is a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. I built a classifier that routes incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues, served by FastAPI, with nightly retraining run through a Celery worker on Redis. That system improved macro-F1 to 0.88 from 0.62 for the old keyword rules, and reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes. That experience maps well to maintaining reliable background processing and improving production systems over time.

I also built a contract clause search assistant for a legal client using Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI. It answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used. It reached 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set, and reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That project strengthened my experience with retrieval workflows, large document sets, and building AI features that are useful in real production settings.

For your role, I’d be comfortable collaborating with your team to clarify specs, work independently on implementation, and help troubleshoot issues as the application scales. I also have experience with Celery, PostgreSQL, and machine learning workflows, which should be helpful for your current stack and product direction.

How are you currently handling scaling work between Django, DRF, and Celery as product volume grows?
